deliverCard.title: What we actually deliver

bullets.suffix: that normalizes HR, Finance, and Real Estate data without forcing you into a new tool.

deliverCard.outcomeBody: You stop building one-off dashboards and start operating a scalable decision engine.

problem.title: The issue is not reporting. It is architecture.
problem.body: Most CRE stacks were built to capture reality (payments, work orders, lease abstracts). They are great at looking backward. They struggle to forecast and connect decisions to P&L, employee experience, ESG goals, and risk. That gap turns teams into manual data janitors.

cards.title: The 80/20 trap
cards.body: Teams spend most of their time aggregating disconnected data and too little time making decisions.

cards.title: The vendor bias
cards.body: Service-provider data models optimize delivery for the vendor, not the occupier's strategy.

cards.title: The IT bottleneck
cards.body: Generalist data projects take years because the CRE semantics and grain are missing.

solutionCore.title: Our solution: a semantic layer for strategy
solutionCore.body: We deploy a proprietary Common Data Model designed for the corporate occupier, accompanied by a CRE ontology that encodes context and relationships.

features.title: Neutrality
features.body: Agnostic to your service providers and software. Normalize across HR, Finance, and CRE.

features.title: Speed
features.body: Automate data engineering and modeling work dramatically faster than generalist approaches.

features.title: Future-proofing
features.body: Structure data for deterministic results so enterprise AI can calculate with precision.

cards.title: One version of truth
cards.body: HR, Finance, and Real Estate stop reconciling competing numbers and start using shared logic.

cards.title: Reusable decision logic
cards.body: Once you model Total Cost of Occupancy, it powers Finance, Ops, and Strategy simultaneously.

cards.title: Faster cycles
cards.body: Replace quarterly Excel wars with automated, auditable narratives on demand.

decisionAccelerator.title: The Decision Accelerator
decisionAccelerator.body: A 3-step method to build the foundational, AI-ready data asset that models the reality and possibilities of your portfolio.

steps.title: Diagnose
steps.body: Your IT team builds the lakehouse. We bring meaning: translate CRE reality into the data design so infrastructure supports decisions, not just specs.

steps.title: Deploy
steps.body: Implement a Common Data Model that enforces consistency. Solve grain and fidelity issues so you can model real financial outcomes (not oversimplified aggregates).

steps.title: Deliver
steps.body: Stop one-off reporting. Stand up an AI Factory: reusable logic and analytics components that scale across teams and questions.

expectations: Clean interfaces for BI tools (Power BI / Excel)

valueDelivered.title: Value delivered
valueDelivered.body: The result is not a new piece of software. It is a new way of working: more strategic capacity, faster decisions, and higher trust in the numbers.

items.title: Unlock strategic capacity (the 80/20 flip)
items.body: Automate the manual aggregation cycle so your team spends time managing the portfolio, not prepping spreadsheets.

items.title: Context-aware precision
items.body: Align the model to your grain, hierarchies, and P&L logic so outputs match your organization's reality.

items.title: Faster, smarter decisions
items.body: Compress time between market signals and strategic moves by replacing fragile reporting cycles with automated analytics.

items.title: Deterministic AI foundation
items.body: A governed semantic layer that supports AI that calculates outcomes with precision rather than guessing from messy inputs.

cta.title: Want to see how this fits your stack?
cta.body: We can map your current systems and show the fastest path to a decision-ready model.
